mission: Make customer-inspectable, reproducible security evidence the highest-priority R&D output for Standment.

senju_collaboration.rule: Senju improves research-process quality and reproducibility. It never receives third-party targets, credentials, exploit instructions, or authorization scope.

tracks.title: Standment Security Scan dogfood + Before/After case study
tracks.hypothesis: Repeated dogfooding on owned assets plus before/after evidence will turn Security Scan from a build artifact into a credible customer-facing case study.
tracks.deliverable: Human-readable scan report, before/after remediation evidence, reproducibility notes and bounded limitations.
tracks.customer_problem: A buyer cannot judge whether a security assessment reduced real exposure when findings and remediation proof are separated or purely technical.
tracks.customer_value: A single before/after case study lets a buyer see the original weakness, the applied defensive change, the retest result and the residual limitation without reading source code.
tracks.commercial_use: Use as evidence for Standment Security Baseline Assessment and Hardening Sprint conversations; it is proof of delivery method, not proof of demand or revenue.
tracks.success_criteria: On an owned asset, publish a human-readable baseline, at least one verified remediation before/after, a reproducible retest, limitations and evidence links.

tracks.title: Customer Security Evidence Pack
tracks.hypothesis: A standard evidence-pack contract will reduce the distance from verified engineering work to a customer-inspectable security deliverable.
tracks.deliverable: Evidence Pack template covering finding, severity, proof, remediation, retest, limitations and rollback.
tracks.customer_problem: Security work is difficult to approve, review and reuse when findings, proof, remediation and retest evidence live in different tools or engineer-only logs.
tracks.customer_value: A standardized pack gives the customer one readable record of what was found, what changed, what was retested, what remains open and how to roll back.
tracks.commercial_use: Use as the standard delivery artifact behind Baseline Assessment, Hardening Sprint and Continuous Defense engagements.
tracks.success_criteria: Produce one complete human-readable evidence pack from a verified owned-system change and independently confirm every required field is present and traceable.

tracks.title: Software supply-chain evidence portfolio
tracks.hypothesis: Combining CodeQL, dependency review, SBOM and security-gate evidence into one reproducible pack will create a stronger defensive security portfolio artifact.
tracks.deliverable: Supply-chain assurance evidence pack with repeatable checks and clear pass/fail boundaries.
tracks.customer_problem: Repository security controls often exist as separate CI jobs, making it hard to tell whether source, dependencies and build provenance are covered consistently.
tracks.customer_value: A combined evidence pack makes coverage, failures and remediation boundaries visible in one place and supports repeatable review after dependency changes.
tracks.commercial_use: Use as a defensive CI/CD and software-supply-chain hardening module inside Standment security engagements.
tracks.success_criteria: Generate a repeatable pack on an owned repository showing CodeQL, dependency review, SBOM and security-gate evidence with explicit pass/fail and limitations.

tracks.title: Auth / tenant / RLS defensive evidence kit
tracks.hypothesis: A fail-closed, evidence-first checklist for owned databases will make authorization and RLS findings safer to remediate and easier to explain to customers.
tracks.deliverable: Owned-system authorization review kit with caller mapping, before/after grants, policy evidence and rollback proof.
tracks.customer_problem: Authorization and tenant-isolation changes are risky when the actual caller, grants, policies and rollback path are not visible together.
tracks.customer_value: A fail-closed review kit lets a customer see who can access what before and after a change and preserves rollback evidence if the remediation breaks intended access.
tracks.commercial_use: Use as an authorization/tenant-isolation review module for SaaS and AI application hardening on explicitly authorized systems.
tracks.success_criteria: On an owned database, capture caller map, effective grants/policies, one bounded defensive change or verified no-op, retest results, rollback evidence and residual risk.

tracks.title: Autonomous-agent security and auditability pack
tracks.hypothesis: Explicit action boundaries, evidence trails and independent verification can become a differentiated defensive-security portfolio for autonomous AI systems.
tracks.deliverable: Agent-security architecture note plus auditable run evidence, failure cases and independent verification.
tracks.customer_problem: Autonomous AI systems are difficult to trust when action boundaries, approvals, failures and evidence are hidden inside prompts or logs.
tracks.customer_value: An auditable pack makes allowed actions, denied actions, evidence trails, independent checks and recovery behavior inspectable by a human reviewer.
tracks.commercial_use: Use as a governance and defensive-control assessment module for organizations operating autonomous AI workflows; internal evidence is not external market validation.
tracks.success_criteria: Publish an inspectable architecture/evidence pack from an owned agent workflow showing bounded permissions, denied unsafe action, audit trail, failure/recovery case and independent verification.
